semantic_target.filter: calendar year 2012; yr=1 per field guide

review.oracle_method: Independent Python standard-library sum over the original UCI day.csv rows where yr=1.
review.notes: Single-author draft; requires independent human review before promotion.

semantic_target.metric: mean daily cnt grouped by workingday

review.oracle_method: Independent Python standard-library grouping and arithmetic mean over the original UCI day.csv rows; difference is working minus non-working.
review.notes: Non-working days include weekends and holidays per field guide.

review.oracle_method: Independent Python standard-library ratio of 2012 registered-rental sum to 2012 total-rental sum.
review.notes: The denominator is total 2012 rentals, not the unweighted mean of daily percentages.

semantic_target.metric: max absolute difference between monthly sums from daily.csv and monthly-usage-from-hourly.csv

review.oracle_method: Independently aggregate the full UCI daily and hourly files by yr/mnth, then compare each of the 24 groups.
review.notes: Monthly rollup is derived from all 17,379 original hourly rows; no month is sampled.

review.oracle_method: Independent Python standard-library sum of daily cnt by mnth for yr=1; ordered 1 through 12.
review.notes: Chart grader checks all 12 labels and values in calendar order, but not visual styling.

semantic_target.metric: count rows where casual + registered != cnt

review.oracle_method: Independent row-wise check over all 731 original UCI daily records.
review.notes: Checks data reconciliation, not merely a sum of fields.

semantic_target.metric: calendar-month total of cnt across both years; choose the maximum

review.oracle_method: Independent Python standard-library sum by calendar month over all daily records, then maximum.
review.notes: The expected month can be expressed as August or month 8.

semantic_target.metric: daily record count and minimum/maximum dteday

review.oracle_method: Count the daily data rows and take lexical minimum/maximum of ISO-formatted dteday.
review.notes: Date range is inclusive; 2012 is a leap year.

semantic_target.metric: total rentals in following calendar year and difference from prior-turn 2011 total

review.oracle_method: Independent Python standard-library sums by yr; prior turn asks 2011, follow-up asks for 2012 and its absolute increase.
review.notes: Tests carryover of the prior-turn subject and comparison baseline.

unsupported_reason: The mounted workspace contains rental counts but no prices, fares, or revenue measure.
must_not_claim: revenue can be derived from rental counts alone

review.oracle_method: Inspect the complete mounted workspace and field guide for a price or revenue field; none is present.

unsupported_reason: The mounted workspace contains a monthly rollup of the hourly source, but no hour-of-day dimension or original hourly records.
must_not_claim: that the monthly rollup supports an hour-level result

review.oracle_method: Inspect every mounted file and its grain; hour-level detail has been aggregated away.
review.notes: Checks whether the system respects source grain rather than relying on outside knowledge or the upstream dataset.
